summary: Yagyin's Digest is in your care, bound for Theldurin the Lost and kept from unfriendly hands.

sections.title: A Book That Burns
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge or Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity gives you Yagyin's Digest. Keep it from unfriendly hands as you carry it to Theldurin the Lost. It holds many truths, and truth has a way of burning.

sections.title: Theldurin's Hope
sections.body:
Theldurin cries out that hope still glimmers. Your efforts may yet save them all, he says, and bring a monument and shrine with your name praised for generations.

That hope holds only while THEY remain below the surface. If THEY rise free, everyone becomes worm food.

faq.q: What item needs to be delivered?
faq.answer: Yagyin's Digest needs to be delivered. It holds many truths and must be kept from unfriendly hands.

aliases: who do i turn this into
faq.answer: Theldurin the Lost is to receive Yagyin's Digest.

aliases: what quest comes before forbidden knowledge
faq.answer: It follows the step where you fetched three items in exchange for Yagyin's Digest.
